title: Your Brain Deletes Most Of What You Experience
description:
Every second your senses deliver far more information than you could ever process, so almost all of it is discarded before you notice.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: Every second your senses deliver far more information than you could ever process, so almost all of it is discarded before you notice.
What survives is what your brain decided mattered, and that decision is based on old priorities rather than present ones.
This is why you can walk the same route for years and not remember a single detail of it. Nothing triggered a reason to keep it.
It also explains why traumatic memories are so sharp and so incomplete. The recording system keeps the emotion and drops the context.
You can bias the system deliberately. Novelty, emotion and attention all mark a moment as worth keeping.
A day with nothing new in it will be deleted almost entirely. That is not a memory flaw. That is the design.
